k:HH.Setting.city.taxiArrivalFee.Desc: What an arriving guest pays the colony for being set down at the stand.
k:HH.Setting.city.taxiDepartureChance: Chance to take a taxi when leaving
k:HH.Setting.city.taxiDepartureChance.De: Share of departing guests who call a taxi when a free taxi stand exists (rises with wealth).
k:HH.Setting.city.taxiFare.Desc: What a departing guest pays for the ride from the taxi stand.
k:HH.Setting.city.taxiWaitTicks.Desc: How long a guest waits at the stand before the cab lifts off.
k:HH.Setting.core.creatorPawn: The author may wander the rim
k:HH.Setting.core.creatorPawn.Desc: Like the creator pawns of the base game, Hearth & Harbor's author can turn up now and then as a generated pawn: a kind, hard-working wandering innkeeper.
k:HH.Setting.core.guide.Desc: The learning helper at the top right. Right-click it to hide it.
k:HH.Setting.core.helpHint: Show the small real-life help hint where you gamble
k:HH.Setting.core.helpHint.Desc: A small, quiet line on every screen where you yourself gamble: if gambling is a problem in real life, help exists (findahelpline.com). Never shown elsewhere.
k:HH.Setting.core.music.Desc: Our three calm songs (one for spring and summer days, one for autumn, one for winter) join the normal RimWorld playlist. When hosting: only in colonies that use Hearth & Harbor (a guest bed, a venue sign or a bank account).
k:HH.Setting.core.musicShare: How often our songs come up
k:HH.Setting.core.musicShare.Desc: Weight of our songs in the playlist compared with one vanilla song. 1 = like any other song of the season, 0 = never.
k:HH.Setting.core.rngAlgorithm.Desc: Algorithm for all Hearth & Harbor random streams. Same odds for all, only the sequence differs. ChaCha8 is cryptographic (paranoid), SplitMix64 is fastest.
k:HH.Setting.core.sealedFate.Desc: On: reloading a save does not re-roll guest events (everything uses sealed random streams). Player bets, bank trades and lottery are always sealed.
k:HH.Setting.core.windowScale.Desc: All Hearth & Harbor and Silverline windows grow or shrink by this factor (on top of the automatic size for large screens).
k:HH.Setting.dlc.aiIdeoPrecepts: Also give AI ideoligions money precepts
k:HH.Setting.dlc.aiIdeoPrecepts.Desc: Random AI ideoligions get a stance on indulgences and paid ascension once, weighted by their memes. Fixed faction ideoligions are never touched.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.fundDestination.Desc: To the deity: the silver simply disappears. To the faith's faction: if a faction shares the faith, it gains goodwill (+1 per 500 silver, at most +5 per quadrum). Colonists never pay into your own temple fund.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.indulgenceCapScale.Desc: Multiplier on the purchase limits per pawn, colony and ideoligion. 1 = limits as designed.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.indulgenceFactor.Desc: Multiplier on every indulgence and ascension price (the Faith-for-sale factor of the money-and-faith table).
k:HH.Setting.dlc.luckShift: Luck: payout shift of Lucky and Unlucky
k:HH.Setting.dlc.luckShift.Desc: Lucky people get this many percentage points added to a game's payout plan, Unlucky people lose as many. The shift never lifts a game to 100 % or above and never bends the random draw.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.mandatoryBilleting.Desc: Billeting orders of the Empire arrive even below Overbooked. Off: only on hard tiers (Overbooked and higher). Either way only in a colony with guest beds.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.nobleBasePrice: Noble stay base price per noble and day
k:HH.Setting.dlc.nobleBasePrice.Desc: Silver per noble and day before the title bonus (+15 % per 100 seniority) and the satisfaction factor.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.nobleMoneyFactor.Desc: Follows the guest-money row of the difficulty table: richer on easy tiers, poorer on hard ones.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.nobleStays.Desc: Nobles of the Empire may ask for paid lodging. You can always decline. Needs a guest bed in a bedroom that meets their title; they stay as guests and pay at the end, by how happy they were.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.shrineReactions: Colonists react to shrines of other faiths
k:HH.Setting.dlc.shrineReactions.Desc: Proselytizers and supremacists dislike shrines of other faiths on their land; tolerant ideoligions like them.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.xenoHospitality.Desc: Guests' xenotypes and genes shape what rooms and goods they like (dark rooms for sanguophages, cold rooms for yttakin, ...).
k:HH.Setting.finance.fallbackWindow: Investments in the comms console menu
k:HH.Setting.finance.fallbackWindow.Desc: Also offer the investment screens in the comms console float menu, even when the bank window is available.
k:HH.Setting.finance.hazardMult.Desc: Multiplies crashes, rug pulls, defaults, exchange hacks and bank runs. The long-run average does not change, only how often it hurts.
k:HH.Setting.finance.jumpMult.Desc: Multiplies how often assets make their own jumps (quarterly numbers, crypto jumps, memecoin pumps). The long-run average does not change: the maths compensates.
k:HH.Setting.finance.memeInterval.Desc: Average number of days until the next memecoin is listed.
k:HH.Setting.finance.memeOn.Desc: A new memecoin appears every few days and is delisted after three. Most holders lose money, a few get rich.
k:HH.Setting.finance.newsMessages.Desc: Show crashes, rallies and hacks as short messages (only when you hold something affected).
k:HH.Setting.finance.nftOn.Desc: Ownership certificates of pictures. Selling takes one to four days and costs a spread.
k:HH.Setting.finance.omenCapA.Desc: Largest share of your net worth in one Omen chance market.
k:HH.Setting.finance.omenCapB.Desc: Largest share of your net worth in one Omen market on a world event.
k:HH.Setting.finance.omenFee.Desc: Share of every stake kept by the exchange (and again when you close a position early).
k:HH.Setting.finance.omenGamma.Desc: Below 1 the exchange overprices unlikely outcomes (the classic favourite–longshot bias). 1 = quotes equal the true odds.
k:HH.Setting.finance.omenSpread.Desc: Bookmaker's margin: the YES price and the NO price add up to 1 plus this.
k:HH.Setting.finance.profit.Desc: How much invested money grows on average per game year (60 days) for the reference fund RimIndex 50: 1.2 means +20 % a year, 1.0 means plus/minus nothing, below 1 loses money. Log scale 0.1 to 100; type a number for the exact value. Follows the difficulty slider until you set it yourself.
k:HH.Setting.finance.projectStakePct.Des: Largest stake on one project, as share of your net worth.
k:HH.Setting.finance.projectTotalPct.Des: Largest total of all open project bets (Longs and Shorts together), as share of your net worth.
k:HH.Setting.finance.projectYearCapPct.D: Net profit from Longs and Shorts per game year is capped at this share of your net worth at the start of the year. Above it the bank pays the stake back only.
k:HH.Setting.finance.projectsOn.Desc: Factions announce projects; you can invest (Long) or bet against them (Short).
k:HH.Setting.finance.volMult.Desc: Multiplies how wildly prices swing day to day. 1 = the numbers of the design (index 1.5 % a day, memecoins 15 %).
k:HH.Setting.inn.convertPower.Desc: How strongly a talk in the 'Convert' handling shakes a guest's certainty in their own ideoligion (100 % = the usual strength). Needs the Ideology DLC.
k:HH.Setting.inn.coupleWish: Couples wish for a double bed
k:HH.Setting.inn.coupleWish.Desc: Couples who arrive together prefer one double bed. Getting it cheers them up a little, ending up in two single beds annoys them a little. Never changes prices.
k:HH.Setting.inn.doubleBedFactor.Desc: A bed for two earns this many times the price of a single bed. A couple in one double bed pays it together, each half, so they pay less than for two singles.
k:HH.Setting.inn.groupDevGizmos.Desc: In dev mode, the DEV buttons of Hearth & Harbor buildings are folded into one 'Dev: Hearth & Harbor' button so the gizmo row stays readable. Vanilla and other mods' buttons are never touched.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.assessmentDays.De: An accident plan assesses the invalidity grade this many days after the accident (a quadrum by default). Until then the letter shows a preview.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.billingDays.Desc: Premiums are debited automatically every this many days (from the bank account, otherwise the till or silver in storage).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.changeFee.Desc: What Clawback Mutual charges for every change of sum, tier or add-ons of a running policy ("administrative effort"). Free on Standard Room.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.changeLimitPerQua: How often one policy may be changed per quadrum. 0 = unlimited (Standard Room); Overbooked and harder levels limit it.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.changeWaitingDays: After you raise the sum, the tier or add an add-on, claims for events inside this waiting period are still assessed with the old cover (a policy raised one minute before a raid does not pay at the new level). Lowering cover has no waiting period.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.claimLetters.Desc: Clawback Mutual writes a letter for every filed claim (at most one "claim filed" notice per day) and every decision.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.claimMode.Desc: By form: an insured event brings a "claim possible" letter and you file the claim on a form before the deadline (the outcome is rolled exactly as before; the form is cosmetic apart from the payout choice). Automatic: claims are filed for you at the moment of damage.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.claimReminder: Remind me before a claim deadline
k:HH.Setting.insurance.claimReminder.Des: A short reminder letter two days before a filing window closes.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.claimsAttitude.De: How eagerly the claims department finds a reason not to pay. 0 % "Never weasels" · 15 % "Fine print" (Standard Room) · 40 % "Creative accounting" · 75 % "Our lawyers are bored" · 100 % "Basically always".
k:HH.Setting.insurance.deadlineScale.Des: Multiplies the filing deadline of every policy (Wanderlust 5 days, Legal Shield 5 days, property about 15 days at Good Enough; Premium +50 %, Bare Minimum -30 %).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.formError.Desc: Clause 30: the cancellation comes back with a form error. On Standard Room it is re-filed automatically and the deadline stays; harder levels lose a quadrum.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.formTextAi: AI reply to the claim statement
k:HH.Setting.insurance.formTextAi.Desc: When the AI flavour module is on and you agreed to it, the claims department answers your statement in its own words (the amount and the outcome are not changed). Without it the statement is stored and ignored.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.hospitalCapDays: Rim Health Plan: paid sickbed days
k:HH.Setting.insurance.hospitalCapDays.D: The most sickbed days the Rim Health Plan pays per colonist inside the window below (a hospital-indemnity cap; it stops a chronic illness from paying more than the premium costs).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.hospitalCapWindow: The cap above counts the paid days of every colonist over this many days (a quadrum by default).
